dataIdInfo.idPurp: Summarizing Land Use data in each Long Island Sound Basin National Hydrography Dataset Plus (NHDPlus ) Catchment (NHDPlus COMID) by National Land Cover Database (NLCD) Year (2001, 2004, 2006, 2008, 2011, 2013, 2016, and 2019) to assess riparian buffer condition. Prepared as a preprocessing step to the River Basin Export Reduction Optimization Support Tool (RBEROST) model.
dataIdInfo.idAbs:
NLCD land use data (2001, 2004, 2006, 2008, 2011, 2013, 2016, and 2019) reclassed to include only developed (1), forest (4), shrub/scrub (4), and herbaceous (grass, 5) land cover and clipped to 20-, 40-, 60-, 80-, 100-, 300-, and 400-ft buffers of NHDPlus flowlines, waterbodies, and water areas. Zonal Histograms were run for each reclassed and clipped land use raster and the data prepared for input to 00_ProcessRiparianData-Northeast.R, code designed to produce input data for the RBEROST model.

The data was processed using ArcGIS Pro and a series of Python scripts (ReclassNLCD.py, ExtractDatausingBufferMask.py, ZonalAnalysis_SoilsNLCDSlope.py, UpdateNLCDHisttabswithValueDescrip.py, and CreateIntermediateNLCDTable.py).
